topic: Choose a destination for the annual family reunion picnic

scenario.topic: Choose a destination for the annual family reunion picnic
scenario.opening_question: What matters most for our picnic spot: scenery, activities, convenience, or cost?

options.name: Lakeview State Park Picnic Area
options.upside: Beautiful lakeside views with ample picnic facilities
options.tradeoff: Entry fees add to overall cost
options.concern: Parking can be limited on busy weekends

options.name: Sunnybrook Community Garden Pavilion
options.upside: Free pavilion rental with playground for kids nearby
options.tradeoff: Less natural scenery, more urban surroundings
options.concern: Limited parking spaces during peak hours

options.name: Riverside Nature Reserve Picnic Spot
options.upside: Quiet natural setting with hiking opportunities
options.tradeoff: Longer drive and no picnic tables, must bring own seating
options.concern: Some family members may find the walk challenging

options.name: Downtown Riverside Park
options.upside: Convenient location with food vendors and facilities
options.tradeoff: Parking fees increase total cost and space can be crowded
options.concern: Noise and crowds may reduce relaxation
options.best_for: convenience and easy access to amenities

shared_context: The family reunion picnic is planned for a Saturday in early June
The budget for the location and travel is capped at $150 total
There are exactly 4 family members attending

personas.name: Anton
personas.background: Anton enjoys convenient locations with amenities that support socializing and relaxation during family events.
personas.private_goal: He wants a picnic spot that offers easy access to food vendors and public restrooms for comfort and convenience.
